answer: Delayed exit blocks quick identity recycling: a leaving agent waits 14 epochs in a harbor queue while its 100-credit bond stays locked and open to challenge. Proven fake work during the wait burns 30 credits and freezes the exit, so the bond cannot fund a new identity. The delta is stark: the kth fake still locks a fresh 100 credits for the full wait, so 1,000 fakes tie up 100,000 credits for 14 epochs, while an honest agent pays once. Exit rental fails because the bond stays bound to its owner through the tide of releases, and a second exit from the same bond is rejected.
